---
title: Build with ClipMux
icon: Compass
nav: Overview
description: Add uploads, webhooks and private playback to your app, with the Node SDK or the REST API.
---

Your app talks to a ClipMux server the way it would talk to Mux: it creates
uploads, hears about them through webhooks, and plays them with tokens it
signs. The browser talks only to your app. It never sees an API key or a
signing key.

With the Node SDK, the whole integration is one command, one route file, two
elements and three callbacks.

<Tabs items={['npm', 'pnpm']}>
<Tab value="npm">

```bash
npm i @clipmux/node @clipmux/uploader @clipmux/player
npx @clipmux/node init --server https://video.example.com
```

</Tab>
<Tab value="pnpm">

```bash
pnpm add @clipmux/node @clipmux/uploader @clipmux/player
pnpm dlx @clipmux/node init --server https://video.example.com
```

</Tab>
</Tabs>

From any other language, call the REST API and sign playback tokens as
standard ES256 JWTs.
